unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts the p19 opener on the 'stupefying contrast with Russia' and the p21 sentence in which, to recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back to Russia and finds the gap an abyss. The upset of his philosophy now jumps straight to the ice-cap with a bare 'Yet'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The ice-cap of Russian inertia still appears in p21, so the Russia contrast is not wholly gone.

evidence.quote: To recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back across the gulf to Russia, and the gap seemed to have suddenly become an abyss.
It was not the snow, or the arctic gloom, that impressed the tourist, so much as the lights of an electro-magnetic civilization and the stupefying contrast with Russia.
The acceleration was marvellous, and wholly in the lines of unity. Yet the nightmare of the glacial ice-cap still pressed down on him from the hills

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the p21 sentence 'To recover his grasp of chaos, he must look back across the gulf to Russia, and the gap seemed to have suddenly become an abyss.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required. The essential item covers the moment acceleration in the lines of unity upsets his philosophy and the electric lights' contrast with Russia.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The dialectic is flattened. The point is that acceleration toward unity at Hammerfest makes Russia's inertia seem infinitely distant, and this dramatizes the unity/chaos oscillation the CCA doctrine describes.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Hammerfest loses the turn back to Russia that restores 'chaos'

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops two parts of source p10. One is that he could not affirm the synthesis would be chaos, since he would be obliged to deny the chaos. The other is that all are equally servants of the power. 'But the CCA saw light' now follows the horsepower sentence abruptly.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'The darkness was dense' and the duty to accelerate force in p8 survive, so a reader can partly infer the link.

evidence.quote: He could not affirm with confidence, even to himself, that his "largest synthesis" would certainly turn out to be chaos, since he would be equally obliged to deny the chaos.
No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it
drowned rhyme and reason. But the conservative Christian anarchist saw light.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Reinsert 'No one was to blame, for all were equally servants of the power, and worked merely to increase it;' before the final clause. Optionally restore the 'could not affirm' sentence as well.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required. The essential item is 'He admits the darkness'. The cut sentences are not on the optional list.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This loses the mock-rigorous self-undercutting that defines the party's comedy. It also loses the logic by which the anarchist, whose duty is to increase force, 'sees light' where others see darkness.
unresolved_should_improve.title: The CCA's self-cancelling doubt and 'servants of the power' are cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: 'Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them' is cut, along with the New York 'Gotterdammerung' paroxysms. The anarchistic ferments are left unattached, followed by a bare assertion that New York knew Wagner better.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Ternina and New York's 'fascinated horror' still ground New York's understanding later in p4.

evidence.quote: Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion.
Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion.
certain anarchistic ferments, and thought them proof of art. New York knew better than Baireuth what Wagner meant.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the single sentence 'Perhaps they were; and at all events, Wagner was chiefly responsible for them as artistic emotion.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Required. Essential: 'New York and Paris understand Wagner's catastrophe better'. The flood images were optional.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The causal chain from Wagner to the anarchistic ferments to a CCA born 'under the inspiration of the Gotterdammerung' weakens. The ironic 'Perhaps they were' hedge also disappears.
unresolved_should_improve.title: The link between Wagner and the anarchistic ferments is lost

unresolved_should_improve.claim: Cutting 'parents and children' leaves 'them' referring back only to Mrs. Lodge. Cutting the thirty years of resolving to go to Baireuth, together with 'Thirty years earlier', removes the comic delay that the 1876/1901 contrast answers.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Lodge family is inferable from 'the Lodges' later in the chapter.

evidence.quote: He joined them, parents and children, alert and eager and appreciative as ever
For thirty years or thereabouts, he had been repeating that he really must go to Baireuth.
Suddenly Mrs. Lodge appeared on the horizon and bade him come. He joined them at the little old town

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Change to 'He joined the Lodges, parents and children, at...' and restore the 'For thirty years' sentence.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Optional tradeoff. The plan does not list the thirty-year detail.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This causes a small referential stumble. It also loses the irony that the long-postponed pilgrimage arrives too late to teach.
unresolved_should_improve.title: 'He joined them' is left without its plural antecedent, and the thirty-year delay is lost

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops the triangulation of history, the voyages of thought, and the p22 sentence in which the older Teufelsdrockh sees no clearer but is fully as much perplexed. All of these were in the first draft.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: V6 and V7 and the 1830 Teufelsdrockh comparison survive.

evidence.quote: The new Teufelsdrockh, though considerably older than the old one, saw no clearer into past or future, but he was fully as much perplexed.
Education crowded upon him in immense masses as he triangulated these vast surfaces of history
He rambled northwards till he found himself at Trondhjem and discovered Norway. He took the mail steamer to the north

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the p22 opening sentence and the triangulation sentence in p18.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Optional tradeoff, but the cut sentences are not on the optional list.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The title figure loses its closing self-deprecation. The narrator's science-metaphor voice is absent from a section that the plan weights equally with the others, at a word count that appears to be under target.
unresolved_should_improve.title: The Norway passage becomes a bare itinerary, and the newer Teufelsdrockh's perplexity is cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The provisional calculation is removed: a value of inertia for the mass, slow acceleration, and a gap that stays relatively the same. Also removed is 'This result reached'. The epistemic refusal now leads straight to the Lodges' Berlin plan.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Russia lagged' and the three-generations exchange still convey slowness.

One might give a value as movement of inertia to the mass, and assume a slow acceleration
and their relations must be always infinite. The Lodges thought their moral improvement required a visit to Berlin

unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This loses the irony that he 'has nothing to say' yet quietly calculates. It also loses an early instance of measuring history mechanically, which the plan identifies as a forward mechanism.
